sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def state():
    f=current_frame
    rpos=ppos=dot=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['color']=='R': rpos=(r0,c0)
        if n['color']=='b': ppos=(r0,c0)
        if n['color'] in 'Yp' and n['pixels']<=2: dot=(n['color'],r0,c0)
    return ppos,rpos,dot
print("start:", state(), "result:", last_action_result.get('state'))
action(['UP'])
print("after UP:", state(), last_action_result.get('state'), last_action_result.get('stop_reason'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
